svg.title: The Salmon Life Cycle
svg.desc: Eight-stage salmon life cycle: Eggs in gravel, Alevin, Fry, Parr, Smolt, Ocean adult, Returning adult, and Spawning, showing movement from freshwater to the ocean and back.
svg.text: FROM FRESHWATER TO THE OCEAN — AND BACK
Educational schematic • Atlantic salmon, simplified • Not an official IELTS examination diagram
